message.content: let's brainstorm a little app for keeping track of when to water my houseplants

content.text:
Happy to. You can skip the questions and have me start any time.

What happened the last time a plant suffered because of watering?

message.content: I have about 30 plants. I lost a fern last month because I forgot it for two weeks, and I drowned a succulent because I watered it with everything else. some need water every few days, some once a month. I'm always on my phone

content.text:
So the problem is less "remind me to water" and more "each plant has its own rhythm and I can't hold 30 rhythms in my head". I'm guessing the core is a list of your plants, each with its own interval, sorted by what is due today, where one tap marks a plant watered and resets its clock. On your phone, so a phone-first web page you can add to the home screen.

Does that core idea match what you had in mind?
